name: @wocwang/cortico-world-singer-for-coopanion
description: Cortico World for Coopanion: sing from lyrics with DiffSinger (Qixuan voicebank) and an optional RVC pass
author: wocwang

zh.description: 输入一行歌词，用 DiffSinger 自动配旋律唱出来：中文写汉字，换日语声库后写假名也能唱。声库可以放好几个，设置里按「名称 · 语言 · 音色」挑，Normal / Soft 这类音色也能单独切。不装 gpt-sovits 也能单独用：缺共享运行时会自己下一份 CPU 档（约 1 GB，三个插件共用）。全程本机推理，不联网、不训练。默认自动挑设备：显卡档运行时 + onnxruntime-gpu 就绪时走 NVIDIA 显卡（约 0.8 GB 显存，热跑约 0.7 秒一句），否则纯 CPU（约 1.3 GB 内存、不占显存）。可选接 RVC 把干声换成小肥鱼/星落落大肥鱼的音色（indexRate / protect 可调）。另开一个只监听本机的 HTTP 接口（默认 127.0.0.1:9882），其他插件与外部大模型可以用 POST /sing 直接拿 wav。桌宠 / 对话页里想唱时用工具 singer_sing 直接唱到本机声卡，气泡与声音同时开始，不用装 gpt-sovits。默认随 Coopanion 启动拉起唱歌服务，也可以关掉、要用时在面板手动启动。

en.description: Type a line of lyrics and hear it sung by DiffSinger with an auto-generated melody. Chinese lyrics use Han characters; with a Japanese voicebank, kana lyrics are sung too. Keep several voicebanks in one folder and pick one in the settings (label shows name, languages and colours), with a separate switch for colours such as Normal / Soft. Works without the gpt-sovits plugin: if the shared runtime is missing it downloads the CPU tier (~1 GB, shared by all three plugins). All inference runs locally, no training. The inference device is automatic: an NVIDIA GPU (~0.8 GB VRAM, ~0.7 s per line once warm) when the GPU runtime and onnxruntime-gpu are ready, otherwise pure CPU (~1.3 GB RAM, no VRAM). Optionally route the dry vocal through RVC. Also serves a loopback-only HTTP endpoint (127.0.0.1:9882 by default) so other plugins and online LLMs can POST /sing and get a wav back. In the pet window or chat page the bot sings through the singer_sing tool straight to this computer's speakers, with the bubble and the voice starting together — no gpt-sovits plugin needed. The singing service starts with Coopanion by default; you can turn that off and start it from the panel when needed.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm test && npm run typecheck
